short_description: 50+ private offline developer utilities, PDF editor, crypto & formatting tools.
full_description:
OmniTool Hub is an all-in-one private developer and digital creator utility suite designed to operate 100% locally on your Android device. With over 50 offline-ready tools, OmniTool Hub delivers lightning-fast performance, zero network latency, and complete privacy without data leaving your hardware.

🔒 100% PRIVATE & OFFLINE-FIRST
• Zero server tracking, zero analytics telemetry, and zero cloud uploads.
• All PDF processing, text conversions, and cryptographic operations run locally on your device.
• Perfect for enterprise engineers, privacy-conscious professionals, and offline field work.

📄 POWERFUL PDF STUDIO & CONVERTER
• PDF Utilities: Merge multiple PDF documents, split pages, extract text or images, crop margins, and visually reorganize page order.
• Document Converter Hub: Convert between Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx/.csv), PowerPoint (.pptx), Images, Scans, HTML/CSS, and Markdown.
• PDF Editor & E-Sign: Fill AcroForms, draw vector annotations, sign documents, stamp watermarks, and permanently redact sensitive PII.
• PDF Security: Protect documents with AES encryption, remove permissions passwords, repair corrupted headers, and export ISO 19005-compliant PDF/A archives.
• PDF Search & OCR: Search text across multiple documents and run client-side OCR on scanned pages.

💻 DEVELOPER & CODE SUITE
• Data Formatter: Beautify and validate JSON, format messy SQL queries, and convert bi-directionally between JSON, YAML, and CSV.
• JSON-to-Code: Convert JSON schemas into TypeScript interfaces, Python Pydantic models, Go structs, and Rust Serde types.
• cURL Converter: Convert cURL requests directly into modern JavaScript Fetch (async/await), Axios, Python Requests, and Go HTTP clients.
• Regex Studio: Visual regular expression tester, match visualizer, and batch extractor for emails, IPs, phone numbers, and URLs.
• Cron Expression Builder: Build 5-field cron schedules with human-readable English translations and timeline execution forecasts.
• Robots.txt Generator: Visual builder for web crawlers with modern AI scraper rules (GPTBot, CCBot, Google-Extended).

🔐 CRYPTOGRAPHY & SECURITY
• Cryptography Suite: Calculate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 hashes client-side.
• AES-256 Encryption: High-security symmetric encryption and decryption with GCM authentication.
• RSA Key Generator: Generate asymmetric 2048-bit and 4096-bit public/private key pairs.
• JWT Decoder: Decode JSON Web Tokens to inspect headers, payload claims, timestamps, and signature validity.
• PII Anonymizer: Scan and mask sensitive personal identifiable information (emails, credit cards, IP addresses) from logs.
• Password & UUID Generator: Generate cryptographic entropy passwords and bulk RFC 4122 v4 UUIDs.

🎨 DESIGN & MEDIA SUITE
• CSS Studio: Visual generator for linear/radial gradients, multi-layer box shadows, and modern glassmorphism cards.
• Color Lab: WCAG contrast ratio compliance checker, palette generator, tints, shades, and color space converter.
• SVG Animator: Path visualizer, keyframe animation presets (draw, pulse, float), and animated SVG export.
• Dynamic QR Studio: Design high-resolution custom art QR codes with gradient fills and logos, or scan codes live via camera.
• Audio & Video Tools: MP3/WAV/OGG audio cross-converter, video-to-GIF converter, and playback speed controller.

📐 MATH & TIME CALCULATORS
• Scientific Calculator: Advanced arithmetic, logarithmic, and trigonometric functions with calculation history.
• Financial Growth Calculator: SIP mutual fund growth, compound interest projections, and amortized loan EMI schedules.
• Date & Time Suite: Unix epoch converter, duration calculator, and dynamic date math arithmetic.
• IP Subnet Calculator: CIDR notation parser, subnet mask calculator, and MAC OUI manufacturer lookup.
• Unit Converter: Instant conversion across storage sizes, weights, lengths, and temperatures.
